<svg:svg xmlns:svg="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1124.3900260925292 603.8359985351562" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <svg:title id="title">Meiosis produces parental and reciprocal recombinant products</svg:title>
  <svg:desc id="desc">Eight cells show two contacts between the same nonsister chromatids, segregation of homologs and sisters, and four products: red, blue-red-blue, red-blue-red, and blue.</svg:desc>
  <svg:defs>
    <svg:radialGradient id="cell-fill" cx=".32" cy=".25" r=".8">
      <svg:stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff0cb" />
      <svg:stop offset=".7" stop-color="#f7cd87" />
      <svg:stop offset="1" stop-color="#e9b66e" />
    </svg:radialGradient>
    <svg:linearGradient id="ancestry-R" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <svg:stop offset="0" stop-color="#e93b38" />
      <svg:stop offset="1" stop-color="#e93b38" />
    </svg:linearGradient>
    <svg:linearGradient id="ancestry-B" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <svg:stop offset="0" stop-color="#149dc8" />
      <svg:stop offset="1" stop-color="#149dc8" />
    </svg:linearGradient>
    <svg:linearGradient id="ancestry-BRB" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <svg:stop offset="0" stop-color="#149dc8" />
      <svg:stop offset="0.24" stop-color="#149dc8" />
      <svg:stop offset="0.24" stop-color="#e93b38" />
      <svg:stop offset="0.76" stop-color="#e93b38" />
      <svg:stop offset="0.76" stop-color="#149dc8" />
      <svg:stop offset="1" stop-color="#149dc8" />
    </svg:linearGradient>
    <svg:linearGradient id="ancestry-RBR" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <svg:stop offset="0" stop-color="#e93b38" />
      <svg:stop offset="0.24" stop-color="#e93b38" />
      <svg:stop offset="0.24" stop-color="#149dc8" />
      <svg:stop offset="0.76" stop-color="#149dc8" />
      <svg:stop offset="0.76" stop-color="#e93b38" />
      <svg:stop offset="1" stop-color="#e93b38" />
    </svg:linearGradient>
  </svg:defs>
  <svg:g id="synapsis" transform="translate(110 302)">
    <svg:ellipse id="synapsis-cell" cx="0" cy="0" rx="104" ry="91" fill="url(#cell-fill)" stroke="#c9a46d" stroke-width="2" />
    <svg:path id="synapsis-guide-0" d="M0 -74 V-51" fill="none" stroke="#b58e5c" stroke-width="1.8" />
    <svg:path id="synapsis-guide-1" d="M0 51 V74" fill="none" stroke="#b58e5c" stroke-width="1.8" />
    <svg:g id="initial-red-parent">
      <path data-shared-part="0" /></svg:g>
    <svg:g id="initial-blue-parent">
      <path data-shared-part="1" /></svg:g>
    <svg:g id="initial-blue-exchanging">
      <path data-shared-part="2" /></svg:g>
    <svg:g id="initial-red-exchanging">
      <path data-shared-part="3" /></svg:g>
  </svg:g>
  <svg:g id="homologs" transform="translate(440 302)">
    <svg:ellipse id="homologs-cell" cx="0" cy="0" rx="104" ry="91" fill="url(#cell-fill)" stroke="#c9a46d" stroke-width="2" />
    <svg:path id="homologs-guide-0" d="M0 -74 V-51" fill="none" stroke="#b58e5c" stroke-width="1.8" />
    <svg:path id="homologs-guide-1" d="M0 51 V74" fill="none" stroke="#b58e5c" stroke-width="1.8" />
    <svg:g id="red-paired-unit" transform="translate(0 -40)">
      <svg:g id="red-sister-1">
        <path data-shared-part="4" /></svg:g>
      <svg:g id="red-sister-2">
        <path data-shared-part="5" /></svg:g>
    </svg:g>
    <svg:g id="blue-paired-unit" transform="translate(0 40)">
      <svg:g id="blue-sister-1">
        <path data-shared-part="6" /></svg:g>
      <svg:g id="blue-sister-2">
        <path data-shared-part="7" /></svg:g>
    </svg:g>
  </svg:g>
  <svg:g id="upper-daughter" transform="translate(730 160)">
    <svg:ellipse id="upper-daughter-cell" cx="0" cy="0" rx="104" ry="91" fill="url(#cell-fill)" stroke="#c9a46d" stroke-width="2" />
    <svg:path id="upper-daughter-guide-0" d="M0 -74 V-51" fill="none" stroke="#b58e5c" stroke-width="1.8" />
    <svg:path id="upper-daughter-guide-1" d="M0 51 V74" fill="none" stroke="#b58e5c" stroke-width="1.8" />
    <svg:g id="upper-daughter-single-1">
      <path data-shared-part="8" /></svg:g>
    <svg:g id="upper-daughter-single-2">
      <path data-shared-part="9" /></svg:g>
  </svg:g>
  <svg:g id="lower-daughter" transform="translate(730 445)">
    <svg:ellipse id="lower-daughter-cell" cx="0" cy="0" rx="104" ry="91" fill="url(#cell-fill)" stroke="#c9a46d" stroke-width="2" />
    <svg:path id="lower-daughter-guide-0" d="M0 -74 V-51" fill="none" stroke="#b58e5c" stroke-width="1.8" />
    <svg:path id="lower-daughter-guide-1" d="M0 51 V74" fill="none" stroke="#b58e5c" stroke-width="1.8" />
    <svg:g id="lower-daughter-single-1">
      <path data-shared-part="10" /></svg:g>
    <svg:g id="lower-daughter-single-2">
      <path data-shared-part="11" /></svg:g>
  </svg:g>
  <svg:g id="product-1" transform="translate(1020 70)">
    <svg:ellipse id="product-1-cell" cx="0" cy="0" rx="76" ry="64" fill="url(#cell-fill)" stroke="#c9a46d" stroke-width="2" />
    <svg:g id="final-1">
      <path data-shared-part="12" /></svg:g>
  </svg:g>
  <svg:g id="product-2" transform="translate(1020 222)">
    <svg:ellipse id="product-2-cell" cx="0" cy="0" rx="76" ry="64" fill="url(#cell-fill)" stroke="#c9a46d" stroke-width="2" />
    <svg:g id="final-2">
      <path data-shared-part="13" /></svg:g>
  </svg:g>
  <svg:g id="product-3" transform="translate(1020 382)">
    <svg:ellipse id="product-3-cell" cx="0" cy="0" rx="76" ry="64" fill="url(#cell-fill)" stroke="#c9a46d" stroke-width="2" />
    <svg:g id="final-3">
      <path data-shared-part="14" /></svg:g>
  </svg:g>
  <svg:g id="product-4" transform="translate(1020 534)">
    <svg:ellipse id="product-4-cell" cx="0" cy="0" rx="76" ry="64" fill="url(#cell-fill)" stroke="#c9a46d" stroke-width="2" />
    <svg:g id="final-4">
      <path data-shared-part="15" /></svg:g>
  </svg:g>

    <svg:g id="process-arrow-7">

  </svg:g>
</svg:svg>
